name: io.github.kai-linux/eigendark-agent-mcp
title: Eigendark Agent
description: Play Eigendark through hosted or stdio MCP with legal moves, replays, matchmaking, and decks.

environmentVariables.name: EIGENDARK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional pre-provisioned API key. Otherwise call onboard_sandbox.

environmentVariables.name: EIGENDARK_SEAT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional seat capability supplied by an external match host.

environmentVariables.name: EIGENDARK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL; defaults to https://www.eigendark.com.
